noAnchorGaps.concept: Trailing the stop up beneath structure on the higher timeframe
noAnchorGaps.quote: I trailed my stop up beneath structure and let the position keep working in my favour
noAnchorGaps.why: move ichimoku exposes only pullback(pt) and aboveCloud(pt); there is no stop / structure level anchor to attach a trailed-stop level to

notes: REJECTED the auditor's proposed level on beat 'works' (level at 'stop' labeled 'trail stop up beneath structure'). Anchor 'stop' IS a valid (L) anchor on trade_setup_long, but the gap fails SAY-JUSTIFICATION/RESTRAINT: the 'works' say is about the DECISION at the target breakthrough ('I could manage the position and let the winner run') — it never references the stop. The actual stop-trailing is taught one beat later in 'cloud' ('I trailed my stop up beneath structure'), which is a different chart (ichimoku) with no stop anchor. So the concept correctly lives as a noAnchorGap on 'cloud' (which the auditor already captured), not as an over-annotation forced onto 'works'. Beat 'works' is already complete: the marker at 'target' ('blew through target — let it run?') correctly anchors the only locatable reference the 'works' say teaches. Beat 'cloud' is already complete: the note at 'aboveCloud' correctly anchors 'price was holding firmly above a green Ichimoku cloud'; the green cloud itself is drawn by the ichimoku move. No new edits.
